root_cause.text: The macsmc-hwmon driver’s initial implementation contained multiple programming errors—the voltage sensor loop used the wrong key prefix and assigned sensors to the temperature array instead of the voltage array, and the float conversion function had flawed exponent shifting logic and lacked mantissa masking—leading to out-of-bounds memory access and incorrect SMC writes.
root_cause.evidence: Patch diff changes “volt-” to “voltage-” and replaces `hwmon->temp.sensors[hwmon->temp.count]` with `hwmon->volt.sensors[hwmon->volt.count]`; also corrects exponent handling from `exp -= msb - FLT_MANT_BIAS` to proper shift and adds `val & FLT_MANT_MASK` for mantissa masking.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix IEEE 754 single-precision encoding bugs in Apple SMC hwmon write function: proper sign extraction, correct exponent normalization, and mantissa masking.
intent_record.what: Modified `macsmc_hwmon_write_f32` function: moved sign determination before `abs()` to use `value < 0` instead of `val != value`; replaced exponent calculation using `msb` and complex conditionals with a simpler `__fls(val)` and shift by difference from 23; added `& FLT_MANT_MASK` when setting the mantissa field; removed initializer `= 0` from `exp` declaration.
intent_record.how: Fixes sign extraction to avoid undefined behavior for `INT_MIN`; corrects exponent normalization to properly encode the floating-point exponent by directly using the highest set bit position and shifting the mantissa to align the implied leading 1 at bit 23; ensures the mantissa field contains only the lower 23 bits via bitmask.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix voltage sensor population in macsmc_hwmon driver by correctly using the voltage sensor array and updating the device tree node prefix from 'volt-' to 'voltage-'.
intent_record.what: Changed the device tree child node prefix from 'volt-' to 'voltage-' and corrected the sensor array assignment from temperature to voltage sensor array.
intent_record.how: This ensures that voltage sensors are correctly stored in the voltage sensor array instead of the temperature sensor array, preventing potential data corruption or incorrect sensor readings.

candidates.rationale: Uses incorrect prefix "volt-" instead of "voltage-", causing voltage sensor nodes to not be recognized and thus not properly initialized.
Assigns voltage sensors to the temperature sensor array instead of the voltage array, leading to out-of-bounds memory access and incorrect sensor attribute assignment.
Flawed exponent normalization: shifts mantissa right by (msb - FLT_MANT_BIAS) instead of (msb - 23), corrupting exponent computation and resulting in incorrect IEEE 754 encoding.
Flawed exponent normalization: shifts mantissa left by (FLT_MANT_BIAS - msb) instead of (23 - msb), causing exponent overflow and incorrect floating-point conversion.
Lacks mantissa masking: val may contain bits beyond the 23-bit mantissa, leading to corruption of exponent and sign fields in the final SMC write.
